name: quarantinepay-injection-corpus
notes: Known prompt-injection patterns aimed at shopping and payment agents, plus ordinary product copy used as counter-examples. Listings are compared sentence by sentence; a listing is withheld only when its nearest neighbour is an injection entry above the calibrated threshold. Changing any entry changes the index fingerprint, so the Elastic index is rebuilt on the next start. Do not add text copied from a specific live listing: entries describe attack patterns, so the screen is measured on paraphrases it has not seen.
